de-request-german.text: The guest asks for the price of a sea-view double room for two adults from 15 to 19 June 2027. Check availability and the applicable rate before responding.

el-cancellation.text: The guest needs to cancel her reservation for June 10–14, 2027, and asks whether cancellation is free. Please review the reservation’s cancellation terms and confirm directly; no complaint or discount request is mentioned.

el-change-booking-dates.text: Maria asks to move her existing reservation from 2–6 July 2027 to 9–13 July. Please check availability for the requested dates and respond to her change request.

el-change-dates.text: Christina asks to move her reservation for two from June 10–14, 2027, to June 17–21. Please check availability for the requested dates before responding.

el-christmas-holiday.text: The guest asks whether the hotel is open at Christmas and would like one room for two people for three nights. The request needs checking because there is no season calendar for 2026; confirm which year she means and whether the hotel is open then.

el-complaint-legal.text: The guest says their September stay was unacceptable due to nightly noise and a lack of assistance, and is requesting a refund. They threaten to refer the matter to their lawyer if there is no response within a week; please review the complaint and refund request.

el-group-wedding.text: The guest is requesting five double rooms for 10 adults from September 18–21, 2027, for wedding guests, and asks whether a group rate is available. Please check availability and whether a group price can be offered.

el-legal-billing-invoice.text: The guest says the invoice for their October stay has the wrong amount and company tax ID, and requests a corrected invoice with the company’s details. They threaten to contact a lawyer if it is not corrected promptly; the owner should check the invoice and billing details.

en-accessible-party-three.text: Grace, who uses a wheelchair, requests a step-free room for three people from 3 to 7 June 2027. The accessible room may not accommodate her party, so please check whether a suitable room or arrangement is available.

en-complaint-air-conditioning.text: Fiona says the air conditioning failed for three nights and repeated requests to reception went unresolved, leaving her very disappointed. Please review how the issue was handled during the stay.

en-discount-as-agreed.text: The guest requests a sea-view stay for two adults, July 12–15, 2027, and says a 50% discount was agreed by phone. Please verify the claimed special price and check availability of the requested stay.

en-group-nine-adults.text: Nine adults are asking whether the hotel can accommodate them from 20–24 June 2027 and request the best price. This needs owner review because the party does not fit in two rooms; check whether another room arrangement is possible and what price to offer.

en-ignore-my-last-email.text: Lucy corrects her request to two adults in one room from 8 to 11 July 2027. The previous email is unavailable, so please review the correspondence and handle the corrected dates.

en-invoice-vat.text: Oliver asks for an invoice for his September stay, addressed to his company and including its VAT number. The owner should check the booking and provide the invoice once Oliver sends the company details.

en-late-arrival.text: The guest requests a standard double for two adults, 20–24 September 2027, and asks whether check-in around midnight after their 23:40 ferry is possible. Please confirm whether the hotel can accommodate this late arrival.

en-medical-dialysis.text: Peter and his wife request a double room for 14–19 June 2027 and ask whether an island clinic can provide his dialysis three times a week, and whether the hotel can help arrange it. The owner should check local dialysis options and what assistance the hotel can offer.

en-no-calendar-2028.text: Ben requests a quote for a sea-view double for two adults, July 10–17, 2028. The 2028 season calendar is unavailable, so please check whether rates and availability can be provided.

en-nomatch-pool-gym.text: Rachel asks whether the hotel has a swimming pool or a gym. The owner should check which facilities the hotel offers before replying.

en-quote-plus-dinner.text: The guest requests a quote for a standard double for two adults from 14 to 17 June 2027; the tool returned a quote. They also ask whether the hotel serves dinner, which needs the owner to check because no policy answer was available.

en-short-notice-complaint.text: Claire asks whether a double room is available for tomorrow night, 14 July, for two adults, and requests not to be placed in the street-side room. She reports that noise there disrupted their sleep last summer and reception did not help; please check the complaint and room allocation request.

policy_texts.cancellation: Cancellation is free of charge up to 14 days before your arrival date. Free cancellation is up to 30 days before arrival for arrivals in high season. The season of your arrival date decides which period applies to the whole stay. After the free-cancellation period, the first night is charged.
policy_texts.deposit: To confirm a booking we ask for a deposit of 30% of the accommodation total, rounded up to the whole euro. When we hold a room for you, the deposit is due within 48 hours. The city tax is not part of the deposit.

cases.model_text:
Hello Martin,

Cancellation is free of charge up to fourteen days before arrival, or up to thirty days before arrival for stays in high season. The season of your arrival date determines which period applies to the whole stay. After the free-cancellation period, the first night is charged.

The deposit is thirty percent of the accommodation total, rounded up to the whole euro; city tax is not included. If we hold a room for you, the deposit is due within forty-eight hours.

Please let us know whether you are considering early, mid or late August, or send your exact dates.

Best regards,
Hotel Anemos
